metadata.title: Micron, Sandisk and other AI stocks get a lift after Nvidia earnings - MarketWatch

content.text:
15 hours ago
Micron, Sandisk and other AI stocks get a lift after Nvidia earnings
Nvidia's earnings are viewed as a barometer of AI spending, and shares of related companies are rising in Wednesday's extended session.
Sandisk's stock was up 3.7%, while Micron Technology's stock was climbing 3.5%. Nvidia acknowledged pressure from high memory-chip prices on its earnings call.
Meanwhile, Marvell Technology's stock was up 2.9%, Intel's stock was up 1% and shares of both Broadcom and Advanced Micro Devices were up fractionally.
